text:
Type: textured stoneware cylinder vase
Use: holding flowers or stems; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a table, shelf or console
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: matte stoneware with raised wave relief
Colors: white
Shape: tall straight cylinder, open round mouth, flowing diagonal wave ridges across the surface, slim and medium height
Feel: soft, calm, clean
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, greenery; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Textured Stoneware Vase, 13.9"H, White
product.description: This simply and elegantly designed vase will be the perfect accent for your modern-style home decor. Whether holding flowers or standing on its own, this attractive vase will command the space where it resides, and its white color complements most existing home-decor items. 5.12" diameter x 13.9"H 100% stoneware With or without flowers, this vase adds a sophisticated touch to a tabletop or windowsill. Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
